name: PHP2Shell 1.0.0: multipart-header-budget
description: Partial mitigation. See pack README and coverage limits.
raw_conf_text:
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Host "@rx (?i)^(?:protected\.example\.invalid)\.?(?::[0-9]+)?$" "id:AUTO,phase:2,t:none,deny,status:403,log,msg:'SOCFortress PHP2Shell multipart-header-budget',tag:'socfortress/php2shell/1.0.0',chain"
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Content-Type "@rx ^\s*multipart/form-data(?:\s*;|\s*$)" "t:none,t:lowercase,chain"
SecRule &MULTIPART_PART_HEADERS "@gt 100" "t:none"
